entries.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the supplied existing TopLinkSho service illustration. Primary request: remove ONLY the opaque dark navy studio background and the studio ground/floor/reflection beneath the sculpture; deliver the same isolated sculpture as a PNG with REAL alpha transparency. Preserve its exact arrangement, perspective, complete object silhouette, glass/chrome shapes, blue-magenta-lavender colors, glossy materials, sharp edge details and internal reflections. Preserve every foreground component and the physical base/platform if present; do not crop the sculpture. Background and empty spaces between components must be transparent, not painted navy, white, black or a checkerboard. Keep soft semi-transparent edge highlights with clean antialiasing, without a rectangular haze or opaque halo. Keep dark navy where it is an actual material reflection inside an object. Center the full sculpture on a landscape 3:2 canvas with about 8% transparent padding. No new objects, no text, no watermark, no floor, no background glow sheet, no UI/card frame.
